Libraries
```{r}
library(zoo)
library(forecast)

```

EDA
```{r}
df = read.csv("~/Documents/STA137_Final/Temp_NH_1850_2025.csv")
colnames(df) <- c("Year", "TempAnomaly")
str(df)
print(paste0("# of NA's: ", sum(is.na(df))))
min(df$TempAnomaly)
max(df$TempAnomaly)
# Temp Anomaly Distribution Chart
hist(df$TempAnomaly, 
     main = "Temperature Anomaly Distribution", 
     xlab = "Temperature Anomaly")

# Create a time series object
temp.ts <- ts(
  df$TempAnomaly,
  start = 1850,
  frequency = 1
)

# Time series plot
plot(
  temp.ts,
  type = "l",
  col = "blue",
  lwd = 2,
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = "Temperature Anomaly",
  main = "Northern Hemisphere Temperature Anomalies"
)

# Boxplot
boxplot(
  temp.ts,
  main = "Boxplot of Temperature Anomalies",
  col = "lightgreen"
)

# Moving Average plot
ma10 <- rollmean(temp.ts,
                 k = 10,
                 fill = NA)

plot(temp.ts,
     type = "l",
     main = "Temperature Anomalies with 10-Year Moving Average",
     ylab = "Temperature Anomaly",
     xlab = "Year")

lines(ma10,
      col = "red",
      lwd = 3)
```
ACF and PACF
```{r}
# ACF and PACF charts
acf(temp.ts,
    main = "ACF of Temperature Anomalies")
pacf(temp.ts,
     main = "PACF of Temperature Anomalies")
```

ARIMA Model Fitting
```{r}
auto.arima(temp.ts)
AIC(arima(temp.ts, order=c(2,1,2)))
AIC(arima(temp.ts, order=c(2,1,1)))
AIC(arima(temp.ts, order=c(1,1,2)))
AIC(arima(temp.ts, order=c(3,1,3)))
# ARIMA(2,1,2) maybe??? Check more Arigato
```
